question: Are soy milk (TCVN 12443:2018) and nut, oat and rice milks above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml "nước giải khát" under Law 66/2025/QH15 and Decree 360/2025/ND-CP?
why_it_matters: Decides whether core Fami, Veyo and Vinamilk plant milks pay 8% excise from 2027 and 10% from 2028 while dairy is exempt; sets the sugar design rule for TPP-05 host drinks.
cheapest_way_to_close: A written question to the MOF Tax Policy Department (or through the MOF Q&A portal), or an investor-relations question to QNS and Vinamilk.
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of Finance (Tax Policy Department); QNS; Vinamilk

question: What VAT rate (8% or 10%) do Vinasoy and Vinamilk invoice on sweetened plant milks in 2026?
why_it_matters: Revealed industry reading of the law: drinks above 5 g that are excise goods lost the 2% VAT cut from 1 January 2026.
cheapest_way_to_close: One distributor or retailer purchase invoice for Fami and for Vinamilk Sữa Hạt Cao Đạm Ít Đường.
owner_org_to_ask: QNS sales; a modern-trade retailer buyer

question: Will the 2% VAT reduction (Decree 174/2025) be extended beyond 31 December 2026?
why_it_matters: Sets the 2027 VAT on processed foods, dairy and plant milks (8% or 10%) and the size of any gap with excise goods.
cheapest_way_to_close: Watch the National Assembly session of October to December 2026.

question: What share of Vinasoy and Vinamilk plant-milk volume is above 5 g total sugar per 100 ml?
why_it_matters: Sizes the excise exposure (upper bound VND 384 to 480 billion a year for soy milk) and the likely reformulation push.
cheapest_way_to_close: Label audit of the top 20 SKUs using QNS self-declaration files and shelf photos, plus one IR question on sales mix.

question: What share of imports under HS 2106.10, 3504 and 1109 claims ACFTA or RCEP preference (Form E or RCEP certificate)?
why_it_matters: If utilisation is low, part of the MFN duty is paid and the T1 price benchmark is up to 5% higher.
cheapest_way_to_close: Preference-code field in declaration-level customs data (extends DMV-02), or ask two distributors (VMC Group, TDGIMEX).
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs; ingredient distributors

question: Will incumbents reformulate plant milks below 5 g total sugar before 2027, and do the new recipes add protein or fibre?
why_it_matters: A move to protein-fortified sub-5 g drinks would raise T10 market pull; no move leaves it at 4.
cheapest_way_to_close: Compare QNS self-declarations filed in late 2026 and 2027 with 2025 versions; two R&D interviews.

question: What is the current MFN rate on 1109, 1208.10, 2106.10, 3504 and 2202.99 after Decree 21/2025/ND-CP (not identified)?
why_it_matters: Confirms that the MFN rates used for non-FTA origins are current.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the title and annex of Decree 21/2025/ND-CP on Thư Viện Pháp Luật.
